verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports show bulk imports at millions-of-documents scale: 80M documents across indexes, a 7M-article corpus, and 1M records on a small instance. Users also report fast indexing compared with Elasticsearch. Some caveats appear in those reports: initial batch indexing is memory-intensive, one user's early indexing could not keep up until batch indexing fixed it, and another saw indexing fall hours behind on frequently changing records. Missing for 10: any evidence of async task tracking or status polling to know when indexing completes, first-party docs on bulk/batch import throughput, and guidance on payload or upload-size limits.
